facts.fact: On 3 February 2026 the Supreme Committee of the National Centre for Standardization and Metrology, meeting at the Ministry of Planning, adopted the Centre's 2026 plan and a number of Libyan standards, none named as information technology or data standards.
facts.system: National Centre for Standardization and Metrology

systems.system: National Centre for Standardization and Metrology

note: Adopted standards are unnamed; the Libyan Quality Mark licensing regulation, halal meat and GMO rules are non-IT and not facts.
